title: Stream transcript (valid): sequence number wrap from 0xFFFF to 0x0000
description: Serialized SAR stream transcript with SESSION_INIT at sequence 0xFFFE, a DATA_WRITE at 0xFFFF, and another DATA_WRITE at 0x0000, exercising the sequence number wrap-around rule. Validates that wrapping from 0xFFFF to 0x0000 is accepted as continuity. Does not require live TCP/QUIC transport.
notes: This is a serialized SAR stream transcript, not an ordinary static archive.
Sequence numbers increment by exactly one and wrap from 0xFFFF to 0x0000 per spec.
Additional QUIC control streams are not covered here (future transport-vector work).
